summary_1line: Arjuna, grieving and worried about his vow to kill Jayadratha, dreams of Krishna guiding him to seek Shiva and the Pasupata weapon.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a dream, Krishna takes Arjuna by the arm as they soar through the sky over the Himalayas toward a radiant mountain.
Arjuna beholds Shiva on a blazing mountain peak, trident in hand, beside Parvati and surrounded by singing celestial attendants.
Krishna sits facing the east after touching water, calmly advising the grief-stricken Arjuna not to be overcome by sorrow.
